Sai Life Sciences delivers strong growth with healthy operating performance Reported Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 23% YoY, sustaining EBITDA margin Hyderabad, November 05, 2026: Sai Life Sciences Limited (BSE: 544306 I NSE: SAILIFE), one of India’s fastest growing Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CRDMO) announced its financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 2026. Commenting on the performance during the quarter, Mr. Krishna Kanumuri, Managing Director and CEO, Sai Life Sciences Limited, said, “Q2 FY27 was a strong quarter for Sai, with continued business momentum and progress across our key strategic priorities. We see growing traction with global pharmaceutical companies, increasing adoption of our integrated outsourcing model, and continued progress in building the capacity and capabilities required to support customers over the long term. Importantly, we are seeing customer engagements evolve from individual projects into larger, more strategic relationships spanning discovery, development and manufacturing." Mr. Siva Chittor, Chief Financial Officer, Sai Life Sciences Limited added, “We are pleased to report a healthy performance this quarter, with revenue growing by 23% year-on-year. The performance was broad-based, with both CRO and CDMO delivering healthy growth, while EBITDA margins stood at 28%. We continue to expect a stronger second half, supported by the progression of our development and commercial pipeline and the ramp-up of new capacity. Our capacity and capability expansion programme remains on track with a total of ₹621 crore invested in H1 FY27.” Financial Performance: Particulars (₹ crores) Q2FY27 Q2FY26 YoY% H1FY27 H1FY26 YoY% Revenue from Operations 659 537 23% 1,213 1,034 17% EBITDA 187 156 20% 335 281 19% EBITDA Margin% 28% 29% 28% 27% PAT 98 84 17% 172 144 19% PAT Margin% 15% 16% 14%

For Bella Casa Fashion & Retail Limited Sonika Gupta Company Secretary & Compliance Officer Membership No- A38676 Strong H1 FY27 Performance; Revenue up 20% Jaipur, 5 November 2026 – Bella Casa Fashion & Retail Ltd., a leading player in India’s fashion and lifestyle sector, today announced its financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Q2 FY27 Highlights • Revenue: Registered 11% YoY and 16% QoQ growth to ₹139 crores • EBITDA: Stood at ₹8.2 crores; EBITDA margin improved ~100 bps QoQ to 5.9%. • Profit After Tax (PAT): Stood at ₹4.0 crores Key Business Highlights Phasing due to Festival Calendar shift: ➢ With Diwali falling ~3 weeks later this year, festive sales were split between Q2 and early Q3, which was Q2-led last year. ➢ October off-take ahead of Diwali was strong. Customer Addition ➢ Commenced supply to a leading fast fashion retailer (UAE Headquarted Retailer) and a leading home furnishing brand. ➢ We expect the above developments to contribute meaningfully to sales growth going forward. Profit margin ➢ Operating margins recovered in this quarter from Q1 lows, as the input cost increasingly being passed on to customers progressively ➢ Rising capacity utilisation and in-house value-add processes to drive profitability ➢ We expect margins to return to our long-term business model levels Working Capital Management ➢ Debtor: Debtor days increased marginally due to back-ended sales with the start of festive season in the last part of the quarter. We see healthy recoveries in October normalising our debtor levels. ➢ Inventory: Inventory days remained consistent despite of the festive-season demand, highlighting the effectiveness of our JIT and Made-to-Order manufacturing model. All in all, working capital discipline remains at the core of company’s business model. C/1, G Block, Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers Bandra-Kurla Complex, Dalal Street, Mumbai – 400001 Bandra (E), Mumbai – 400051 Scrip Code: 500136 Symbol: ESTER Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Press Release on Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 Please find enclosed herewith the press release on Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Please take the same on your records. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, For Ester Industries Limited ______________________ Poornima Gupta Company Secretary & Compliance Officer Membership No.: A49876 Encl: As above Ester Industries reports strong Q2FY27 performance with Revenue growth of 25.7% EBITDA up by 160.0% Y-o-Y, Margins improve by approximately 510 bps H1FY27: Revenue up 26.5%, EBITDA up 124.6%, Margins improve by approximately 510 bps Gurugram, 04th November 2026: Ester Industries Limited, India’s leading manufacturer of Polyester Films and Specialty Polymers, announced its unaudited financial results (standalone and consolidated) for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Particulars – Standalone Q2 FY27 Q2 FY26 % H1 FY27 H1 FY26 % (Rs.cr) Total Income 365.8 263.3 38.9% 713.5 548.3 30.1% EBITDA (including Non- 28.6 14.0 103.8% 68.6 46.0 49.2% operating income) Margins (%) 7.8% 5.3% 250 bps 9.6% 8.4% 120 bps PAT 6.1 (4.8) - 20.6 4.8 326.9% Particulars – Consolidated Q2 FY27 Q2 FY26 % H1 FY27 H1 FY26 % (Rs.cr) Total Income 449.0 357.2 25.7% 891.0 704.1 26.5% EBITDA (including Non- 45.1 17.3 160.0% 104.0 46.3 124.6% operating income) Margins (%) 10.0% 4.9% 510 bps 11.7% 6.6% 510 bps PAT 7.8 (15.8) - 26.5 (22.9) - Commenting on the performance, Mr. Arvind Singhania, Chairman, Ester Industries said: Improvement witnessed in Q1FY27 continued during Q2FY27 with improving operating environment, higher realizations, increased throughput and a favorable product mix. Consolidated Total Income increased 25.7% Y-o-Y to ₹449.0 crores, while EBITDA more than doubled, rising 160% Y-o-Y to ₹45.1 crores. EBITDA margin expanded significantly to 10% from 4.9% in Q2FY26, reflecting improved operating performance and better business mix resulting from higher contribution of Value- Added products within Film segment and better realizations across product portfolio. PAT turned positive at ₹7.80 crores, compared with a loss of ₹15.8 crores in the corresponding quarter last year. The operating environment for the BOPET Film industry remained stable during Q2 FY27, with the US tariff- related disruptions witnessed in FY26, largely behind us. However, disruptions in crude oil supply and price fluctuations caused by war in West Asia are resulting into higher shipping costs and longer transit time which is adversely impacting working capital cycle. In Specialty Polymers, sales volume was 711 MT in Q2FY27 against 1,161 MT in Q2 FY26, however segment EBIT margin remained healthy at 33.9%. Though one of the marquee products in Specialty Polymers SBU has seen demand erosion but basis the strong product pipeline, and expected customer approval for a new product post marginal capital expenditure in near future is expected to partially make good the lost sales 1 volume & margins. Our performance reflects the strength of our strategy

The acquisition consideration comprises Rs. 25.00 Crore payable in cash and approx Rs. 25.50 Crore through a share swap arrangement involving the preferential issue of 2,25,000 equity shares of Creative Newtech Limited at an issue price of Rs. 1,133.33 per equity share. The Board has also approved convening an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) of the shareholders on Saturday, 28th November 2026, to seek their approval for the preferential issue of equity shares towards the share swap consideration, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018. Zicom SaaS Private Limited is an established player in India's electronic security industry, specialising in Security as a Service (SaaS), intelligent surveillance, 24×7 centralised monitoring, AI-enabled security solutions and managed security services. The acquisition is expected to strengthen Creative Newtech's presence in the surveillance and security solutions industry by combining its established technology distribution network and channel partnerships with Zicom's monitoring infrastructure, technical capabilities and existing customer relationships. Thanking You, Yours faithfully, For Magellanic Cloud Limited Joseph Sudheer Reddy Thumma Chairman & Managing Director DIN: 07033919 Encl.: Press Release MAGELLANIC CLOUD LIMITED Formerly known as South India Projects Limited CIN: L72100TG1981PLC169991 Registered Office: 6th Floor, Dallas Center, 83/1, Plot No A1 Knowledge City, Rai Durg Hyderabad Rangareddi TG 500032 Telephone No.: 040-46515454 www.magellanic-cloud.com info@magellanic-cloud.com Magellanic Cloud Announces Readiness of UAV Facility Premises (Counter Drone) Under Joint Venture; Phased Operational Rollout Planned Pioneering Defence Innovation with Rayonix Tech and XTEND to Deliver Next-Generation Autonomous Tactical Drones for Indian Armed Forces and Security Agencies HYDERABAD, INDIA | November 3, 2026: Magellanic Cloud Limited (NSE: MCLOUD | BSE: 538891) announced that the premises for its advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) manufacturing and testing facility under its joint venture, MCRAY XTEND INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (“MCRAY”), are ready, with the deployment of production and testing capabilities and the commencement of commercial operations planned in phases. The facility forms part of the joint venture announced in April 2026 with Rayonix Tech, in collaboration with Israel-based XTEND. The facility is designed to support the phased rollout of manufacturing, assembly, system integration, testing, and distribution of tactical drone systems powered by XTEND’s proprietary XOS autonomy platform. Key Highlights Joint Venture – Facility Premises Ready: The physical premises are ready to support the planned phased deployment of manufacturing, calibration, system integration, and flight- testing capabilities under one roof. Phased Rollout of Operational Capabilities: Production and testing capabilities will be deployed in phases, with commercial operations planned to commence progressively in alignment with Indian defence and security requirements. 60% Equity Stake in Joint Venture: Magellanic Cloud holds a 60% equity stake in MCRAY. Powered by XTEND’s XOS Platform: MCRAY is positioned as the exclusive manufacturing and distribution partner in India for select platforms running on XTEND’s proprietary XOS operating system, delivering AI-assisted human-guided autonomy, autonomous navigation, and unified multi-domain robotic control.
